subject: maths
question: Average of 8 values is 36. If 4 is subtracted from each of the first three values and 5 is added in the each of the next five values, then what will be the new average?
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 8 values = 36

First three values: 4 is subtracted

Next five values: 5 is added

**Formula Used:**

New Average = (Sum of new values) / Total number of values

**Calculation:**

Sum of original 8 values = 36 × 8

⇒ Sum of original 8 values = 288

Sum of first three values = x

Sum of next five values
 = 288 - x

New sum of first three values = x - 3 × 4

⇒ New sum of first three values = x - 12

New sum of next five values = (288 - x) + 5 × 5

⇒ New sum of next five values = 288 - x + 25

⇒ New sum of next five values = 313 - x

New sum of 8 values = (x - 12) + (313 - x)

⇒ New sum of 8 values = 301

New average = 301 / 8

⇒ New average = 37.625

**The new average is 37.625.**
